Text: Cold store, pier nine. The crate is already packed, so don't open it.
Neon Mile garage, ask for Dex. He pays on delivery, not on promises.
You drove that like it was nothing. It wasn't nothing.
Three laps of the Mile. Six checkpoints. Try not to hit the tram lines.
That's the corner I told you about. The one with the tram lines.
The storm is the point. Nobody looks up when it's raining sideways.
Eleven floors down, four bonds, five minutes. Then we are all strangers.
Four fares, one driver. Marbella Row first, and they're already late.
Ironside crew on the north quay. Stolen containers. Off the books, on the record.
Last warning. Get on the ground.
We lost them. Hold the perimeter.
Suspect in custody. Scene is clear.
